tasks.title: AchiriAgent §17 fix — route through ClawRouter v2.0
tasks.description:
SURGICAL EDIT ONLY. agents/achiri/index.ts had direct fetch() to ANTHROPIC_API_URL — a §17 ClawRouter violation.
1. Removed ANTHROPIC_API_URL constant (line 19).
2. Added import { routeCall } from '../../scripts/lib/clawrouter-v2' after existing imports.
3. Replaced direct fetch() block (provider === 'anthropic' branch) with routeCall({ task_type: 'conversation', tier_class: 'text', complexity: 'apex', context_tokens: 1024, constitutional_flag: true, agent_id: 'achiri', payload: { prompt: systemPrompt + conversationText } }).
4. Removed ANTHROPIC_API_KEY guard — ClawRouter handles auth.
Note: ScriptAgent (originally targeted) had NO LLM calls (Model: NONE, deterministic) — no fix needed there.
